crosswalks.label: Computer Network Architects
crosswalks.rationale: Network architecture grounds topology, modeling, performance and troubleshooting but not application-level P2P semantics.

crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software development grounds protocol/runtime implementation but not network/infrastructure ownership.

findings.summary: P2P engineering spans software protocol implementation and network architecture, requiring explicit separation of transport delivery, environmental reachability and application consistency.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the specialization boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make one-network reachability and transport-delivery evidence distinct from internet-wide compatibility and application consistency.
